author: Matthew C Brown
text:
6/ Swipe files

We are already cyborgs - we bring mini computers with us everywhere and refer to them non-stop.

One of the best ways to take advantage of this is to have an EASILY accessible way to add information. I use the Notes app because its so low barrier.

E.g. "Phrases"

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
7/ Dilate your gaze

Focus on something 1 foot away for 30 seconds.

Then on something 3 feet away for 30 seconds.

And last, on something 10+ feet away for 30 seconds.

Ta Duh! You have rewired your mind to improve focus. 

From the Huberman Labs podcast on ADHD and focus.

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
8/ Diving into a completely new subject?

As 
@tferriss
 shares, if you will read 2-3 books on a subject, you will be ahead of 90% of people.

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
9/ Parkinson’s Law

Work expands to fill the time allotted to it.

Solution = set time limits. 

Try to do in 1 hour what you would normally do in 2.

Remember, “the world rewards you for value added, not time spent” - 
@JamesClear

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
10/ To perfectionists

If you can get an A- in 2 hours, you can get an A in 6.

Is that tradeoff worth it to you (or would you rather get more done)?

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
12/ The foot tap

Have nervous energy?

Shaky legs when speaking? Shaky hands for surgeons?

Problem: too many commands sent telling your body to stay still.

Solution: intentionally command a body part to move. Tap your foot or your finger. Your body will stop quivering.

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
13/ Time blocking

Choose your 3 most important tasks for the week.

Guess the amount of time each task will take. 

Multiply that amount by 1.5x.

Put each of the three tasks on your schedule and make sure you are not interrupted during those hours.

Learned from 
@stephsmithio

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
14/ 
http://
Brain.fm

An app that uses music that scientifically helps you focus.

You can choose 30 minute deep-work sessions,

90 minute light work sessions

Or chill sessions. Free 2-week trial on the app.

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
15/ Pomodoro method

25 minutes deep work, 5 minute rest.

Or 50 minutes deep work, 10 minute rest.

Repeat 2-4x.

Note, you will be super productive but it is exhausting.

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
16/ The one big thing framework

Choose one task that will make today a win. If that’s the only thing you do, you've still won.

Anything extra is exactly that… extra.

Learned from 
@ShaanVP

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
17/ House hack

Buy a single-family home. Live in it. Rent out extra rooms by month or on airbnb.

Buy a 2-4 unit building. Live in it. Rent out extra units.

Subsidize your mortgage (or cover it).

Not easy to do in the current real estate market, but it's definitely possible.

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
18/ To gain muscle

How much protein do you think you need? Minimum  guidelines say 0.36g of protein per pound of body weight.

But if you are trying to gain muscle (you are lifting heavy weights), experts say you need 0.7-1.1g of protein per pound. 

That’s a lot of protein.

topReplies.author: Matthew C Brown
topReplies.text:
19/ "You're the average of the 5 people you spend the most time with." - Jim Rohn

What are your 1-2 priorities for the next 6 months?

Surround yourself with people who are good at those things. 

Can be short-term, can be long-term.
